Starting at 6 PM, savor our Colombian–Venezuelan fusion cuisine at one of the city’s top Latin restaurants. Then, from 11 PM onwards, kick off La Rumba – the hottest Latin party in town. Resident DJ Joshe will be joined each week by a surprise guest DJ to set the dance floor on fire.

From 6 PM, discover our Colombian–Venezuelan fusion fare—perfect for dinner with friends at one of Montreal’s best Latin spots. Then at 11 PM, resident DJ Joshe turns up the heat with the best Latin rhythms: reggaetón, salsa, merengue, bachata and more.
An elegant, festive and welcoming atmosphere—ideal for a Saturday-night out in Montreal.
Join us for Latin Nights every Saturday at the Lounge.","image_fiesta_latina":"events_latin_party_fr"},"email":{"subject":"Thanks for signing up!","message":{"h1":"Hi","h3_1":"This is the team from El Lounge Resto Bar!
